scenes.heading: Building a repeatable order fulfillment workflow

sents.d: Building a repeatable order fulfillment workflow
A consistent fulfillment process prevents shipping delays and errors.

As order volume grows, an ad-hoc fulfillment process — figuring out packing and shipping fresh for each order — becomes a source of delays and mistakes that directly hurt customer experience and reviews.

A repeatable workflow typically includes: a defined packing checklist, standard packaging sizes to reduce decision time, a consistent shipping carrier and rate-comparison process, and a system for adding tracking information automatically where possible.
Setting clear internal shipping-time targets (e.g., all orders ship within 1-2 business days) and communicating them to customers upfront reduces support inquiries asking where an order is.

take: Standardize packing and shipping, and tell customers the timeline.
